description: Converts a GeoJSON FeatureCollection stored in S3 to a tabular DataFrame. Each feature becomes one row; all feature properties become columns; the geometry is converted to a WKT string via shapely. The input dataset is ignored — this profile operates entirely from the source_uri parameter. Typical use: import campus boundary layers, census tract polygons, transit service areas, or alumni ZIP-code polygons for downstream geo-enrichment or spatial aggregation.

source_uri.description: S3 URI of the GeoJSON file to ingest (s3://bucket/key.geojson)

geometry_column.description: Name of the output column that will hold the WKT geometry string (default 'geometry_wkt')

include_bbox.description: Add bbox_minx, bbox_miny, bbox_maxx, bbox_maxy columns from each geometry's bounding box (default false)

output_schema.note: Output columns: all GeoJSON feature property keys + geometry_wkt (and optional bbox columns)
